definitions.explanation: The system of pipes that carries water, gas, or other fluids in a building. Also refers to the work of installing or repairing such pipes.

examples.japanese: {配管|はいかん}{工事|こうじ}のため{水|みず}を{止|と}めます。
examples.english: We will shut off the water for plumbing work.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{建物|たてもの}は{配管|はいかん}が{傷|いた}んでいることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Old buildings often have damaged plumbing.

examples.japanese: {配管|はいかん}から{水漏|みずも}れしている。
examples.english: There's a water leak from the pipes.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{配|はい} (distribute) + {管|かん} (pipe, tube)

Literally "distributing pipes" - the system of pipes that distributes water/gas throughout a building.

TYPES OF {配管|はいかん}:
- {給水|きゅうすい}{配管|はいかん} - water supply piping
- {排水|はいすい}{配管|はいかん} - drainage piping
- ガス{配管|はいかん} - gas piping
- {空調|くうちょう}{配管|はいかん} - HVAC piping

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {配管|はいかん}{工事|こうじ} - plumbing work
- {配管|はいかん}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} - plumber/plumbing contractor
- {配管|はいかん}を{通|とお}す - to run pipes
- {配管|はいかん}が{詰|つ}まる - pipes get clogged

COMMON ISSUES:
- {水漏|みずも}れ - water leak
- {詰|つ}まり - clogging
- {凍結|とうけつ} - freezing (in winter)
- {老朽化|ろうきゅうか} - deterioration (in old buildings)

RELATED WORDS:
- {水道管|すいどうかん} - water pipe
- {排水管|はいすいかん} - drain pipe
